verdict.headline: Not feasible as a leased warehouse at the ₱42,000/sqm asking price: project IRR about 2.5% vs a 12% target. The use supports about ₱9,900/sqm.
conditions: Test a higher-value use, or negotiate the land price
Confirm zoning, title and flood exposure
verdict.thesis_breaker: Paying near the asking price for a warehouse use.
verdict.confidence_note: Real listings and published costs as of 19 Oct 2026; client assumptions illustrative.

project_description.text: A 14,323 sqm vacant commercial lot with direct C6 Road frontage in Calzada–Tipas, Taguig, asked at ₱42,000/sqm (about ₱601.6M), tested as an 8,000 sqm leased dry warehouse.

company_developer.text: Mock client (fictional): a logistics holding company with three completed projects, buying to build and hold.

goals_objectives.text: Acquire, build in 12 months and lease to 3PL and e-commerce tenants; target 12% project IRR over a 10-year hold.

location_analysis.text: Strong access: C-6 widened to four lanes in 2017, linking Taytay to Bicutan, with the planned C6 Expressway adding upside. Taguig had 1.31M residents at the 2024 census.

market_analysis.text: Twelve nearby lot listings are asked at ₱20,000–70,000/sqm (median ₱35,000); the subject is ~20% above the median. Warehouse asking rents run ₱250–500/sqm/month.

technical_study.text: Zoning, title and site studies are not yet confirmed. Steel warehouses cost ₱14,000–22,000/sqm before slab, fire protection and site works.

socio_economic.text: Land in the C-5 and C-6 belts now competes with residential use; the BSP rate is 5.00% with a hike expected.

environmental.text: Lakeshore lowland with a flood history (Ondoy 2009). An elevation survey and flood check are needed; ₱20M site works is budgeted.

financial_projection.text: Total cost ₱834.8M. Stabilised net income about ₱35.0M a year (4.2% yield). Project IRR 2.5%; NPV −₱429.6M at 12%.

findings_recommendation.text: Land is the problem: the use supports ~₱9,900/sqm, or rents of ~₱1,000/sqm at the asking price. Test a higher-value use or negotiate.

conclusion.text: Not feasible as a warehouse at the asking price. The site's C6 frontage and size merit a test of retail or mixed-use, after zoning and flood checks.

key_risks.risk: Land price far above what warehouse rents support

next_steps: Request title, zoning and site studies from the listing broker
Commission an elevation survey and flood check
Test a retail or mixed-use concept on the same site
Benchmark an offer against the ₱35,000/sqm median

claims.text: The subject is a 14,323 sqm vacant commercial lot with direct C6 Road frontage in Calzada–Tipas, Taguig, asked at ₱42,000 per sqm.
Twelve comparable lot listings within about 1.2 km are asked at ₱20,000–₱70,000 per sqm, with a median of ₱35,000 per sqm.
Taguig warehouse asking rents range from about ₱250 to ₱500 per sqm per month; new builds near C6 are asked at ₱450–₱500.
Metro Manila warehouse rents can reach about ₱600 per sqm per month.
Basic steel-frame warehouses cost about ₱14,000–₱22,000 per sqm to build in 2026, excluding land, design, permits and site development.
Taguig had 1,308,085 residents at the 2024 census; Calzada-Tipas had 32,160 residents on 1.07 sq km.
The C-6 Laguna Lake Highway was widened to four lanes from Napindan to M.L. Quezon, opening 9 February 2017.
The 32.7 km C6 Expressway (₱45.29B, San Miguel Corp.) targeted its first phase within two to three years of February 2025.
Lowland areas along Laguna de Bay in Taguig are susceptible to flooding; the city was among the worst hit by Typhoon Ketsana (Ondoy) in 2009.
The BSP policy rate stood at 5.00% in early October 2026, with a further 25 bp hike expected.
At the asking price, the warehouse concept returns a project IRR of 2.5% against a 12% target.
The warehouse concept supports a land price of about ₱9,900 per sqm at a 12% project IRR.
